description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the CandidateStatusAPI class used in the Recruitment API of the OrangeHRM system. It tests methods like retrieving all candidate statuses and checks for not yet implemented methods such as create, delete, and their validation rules.

classes.name: CandidateStatusAPITest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the CandidateStatusAPI endpoints, including fetching all candidate statuses and handling unimplemented methods.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of all candidate statuses using the CandidateStatusAPI and verifies the correctness of the API response.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases data for the testGetAll method from a YAML data source

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Verifies that the create method of CandidateStatusAPI throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Verifies that the getValidationRuleForCreate method throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Checks that the delete method throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Checks that the getValidationRuleForDelete method throws a not implemented exception.
